'''The Electric Tale of Pikachu Special Signature Edition Red Version''' is a [[Pokémon manga samplers|promotional sample]] of the first two chapters of the manga series [[The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]. It is published by [[VIZ Media]] and was included in the first [[Pokémon Video Suitcase]] promotional set. It is 76 pages long and its dimensions are quite small: approximately {{tt|6.0 × 4.0 × 0.2 inches|5.3 × 10.2 × 0.5 centimeters}}. Therefore it is described as a "Viz Mini-Graphic Novel". [[Toshihiro Ono]]'s signature appears on the cover. A second edition, called '''The Electric Tale of Pikachu Special Signature Edition Blue Version''', which contains the second two chapters of the same series, was included with the second Pokemon Video Suitcase set.

==Chapters==
===Red Version===
* Chapter 1: ''[[ET01|Pikachu, I See You!]]''
* Chapter 2: ''[[ET02|Play Misty For Me]]''
===Blue Version===
* Chapter 3: ''[[ET03|Clefairy Tale]]’’
* Chapter 4: ''[[ET04|Haunting My Dreams]]’’

==Important events==
===Red Version===
* {{OBP|Ash Ketchum|EToP|Ash}} begins his Pokémon journey.
* Ash meets {{an|Misty}}.
* Ash meets {{an|Brock}}.
* Ash earns his first two Gym [[Badge]]s.
* Ash captures his first Pokémon.
===Blue Version===
* Ash meets {{an|Professor Oak}} and [[Bill]].
* Oak gives Ash a pre-release version of the New [[Pokédex]].

==Party changes==
===Additions===
=====Red Version=====
* {{AP|Pikachu}} ([[ET01]])
* {{AP|Fearow}} ([[ET01]])
* {{AP|Caterpie|Butterfree}} (Capture not shown, first appears in [[ET02]])
* {{AP|Pidgeotto|Pidgeot}} (Capture not shown, first appears in [[ET02]])
=====Blue Version=====
* {{AP|Beedrill}} ([[ET03]])

===Evolutions===
=====Red Version=====
* {{AP|Metapod|Butterfree}} (evolves in [[ET02]])
* {{AP|Butterfree}} (evolves in [[ET02]])
====Blue Version====
* None of Ash’s Pokemon evolve in this volume.

===Trades===
=====Red Version=====
* No Pokémon are traded in this volume.
=====Blue Version=====
* Ash Trades his newly captured {{AP|Mankey|Primeape}} for a map.

==Gym battles==
====Red Version====
Ash battles the following [[Gym Leader]]s in this volume:
* {{an|Brock}} in [[ET02]] (win)
* {{an|Misty}} in [[ET02]] (win)
====Blue Version====
Ash battles the following [[Gym Leader]]s in this volume:
* [[Sabrina]] in [[ET04]] (loss)
